requires.why: A20: the same host list-update routine used by the lorebook create/import UI, no inference.

effects.scenario: SO-A20 readiness has hydrated the checkpoint.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; if (rt.getSnapshot().requirements.ready) throw new Error('missing book unexpectedly ready'); const wi = await import('/scripts/world-info.js'); if (!(await wi.createNewWorldInfo('SO-A20 Required', { interactive: false }))) throw new Error('book creation failed'); const end = Date.now() + 3000; while ((!rt.getSnapshot().requirements.ready || SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata.scenario !== 'SO-A20 readiness has hydrated the checkpoint.') && Date.now() < end) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50)); if (!rt.getSnapshot().requirements.ready) throw new Error('A20: requirements stale after host lorebook creation'); if (SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata.scenario !== 'SO-A20 readiness has hydrated the checkpoint.') throw new Error('A20: checkpoint effects not hydrated after readiness'); return { created: true, ready: true, hydrated: true };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const wi = await import('/scripts/world-info.js'); if (!(await wi.deleteWorldInfo('SO-A20 Required'))) throw new Error('book deletion failed'); const end = Date.now() + 3000; while (rt.getSnapshot().requirements.ready && Date.now() < end) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50)); if (rt.getSnapshot().requirements.ready) throw new Error('A20: requirements stale after deletion'); return { deleted: true, ready: false };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const wi = await import('/scripts/world-info.js'); await wi.importWorldInfo(new File([JSON.stringify({ entries: {} })], 'SO-A20 Required.json', { type: 'application/json' })); const end = Date.now() + 3000; while (!rt.getSnapshot().requirements.ready && Date.now() < end) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50)); if (!rt.getSnapshot().requirements.ready) throw new Error('A20: requirements stale after host import'); return { imported: true, ready: true };
